scope: development set from the supplied 68-second camera clip

policy.positive: a phone is visibly being viewed, touched or operated by the target person
negative_examples: raised hands or handheld non-phone objects
real phones lying unused on the shared desk

models.grounding: IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny, prompt: mobile phone. smartphone. cell phone.

reason: The best stock-detector policy still labels 18 of 60 hard negatives as PHONE. Object detection cannot by itself distinguish active use from a nearby or unattended handset in this crowded view.
active_preview: Qwen2.5-VL-3B baseline with the talking-only interaction verifier; no stock phone detector override
limitations: Development data, not a held-out accuracy claim
All positive examples are from the visible phone user in one supplied clip
A production decision requires independently labelled camera and time windows
